title: Map the muSrs sources; the Systemic Data Ethics 4x3 map classified standards and GDPR; axes may work best on decisions, and srs and srs-rust have decision logs (2026-11-07)

sections.name: narrative
sections.label: Narrative
sections.content:
There may be some value in building a map of the sources in muSrs.

Or, if you use the coda Mcp you will find a dataset for systemic data ethics. That has a classification process that used a 4x3 semantic map (zodiac based) to classify data ethics standard and gdpr

/home/Greenman/Dropbox/systemic ethics/auto classification is an export of some of the coda data

The axes may tend to work best on decisions. SRS and srs-rust should have a set of decision logs

sections.name: source
sections.label: Source
sections.content: The owner, in conversation with Claude Code, 2026-11-07, three messages sent while the boundary-first axes experiments and the boundary lab were running; recorded verbatim as one vignette.
